The «Book» buttons on doctor cards on the old site led to «#» — nowhere. Calling at night, on the road or at work is inconvenient.

No prices

Every service says «Specialist consultation — from» with no number. Patients go where the price is visible.

Google thinks the clinic is in Fergana

The site's search description says «a modern clinic in Fergana» with the keyword «klinika Farg‘ona», though the branches are in Tashkent and Andijan.
